card.name: Words just before archive or archaeology
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (the, a comma, is, on, |) where the next word is likely to be archive, archives, or archaeology. Seen on web pages with archive menus, old-material notices, and lists of subjects.

modes.label: Before archive
modes.description: A linking word right before a site archive or archived material is named.

modes.label: Before archaeology in a list
modes.description: A comma in a list of academic fields where archaeology comes next.

modes.label: Site navigation
modes.description: A separator or small word in a page menu or notice where an archive link could follow.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word begins with arch, such as archive or archaeology.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a likely 'archive' or 'archaeology'.
